photos.c: Top right: Shelley Newman also improved her club record in 2002 - taking the discus mark out to 60.29m. She took the bronze medal in the Commonwealth Games in Manchester, was a finalist in the European Championships in Munich, and still found time to compete in Southern League and Cup Final teams.

Above right: Setting new Belgrave standards in all that she does, Shelley Newman became Belgrave's first ever female medallist at a Commonwealth Games, taking bronze in the discus with 58m 13cm. Husband Lee was 11th in the shot and 8th in the discus.
